areacello.comment: Cell areas for any grid used to report ocean variables and variables which are requested as used on the model ocean grid (e.g. hfsso, which is a downward heat flux from the atmosphere interpolated onto the ocean grid). These cell areas should be defined to enable exact calculation of global integrals (e.g., of vertical fluxes of energy at the surface and top of the atmosphere).
areacello.grid: native gx1v7 displaced pole grid (384x320 latxlon)
areacello.experiment: all-forcing simulation of the recent past

chl.long_name: Mass Concentration of Total Phytoplankton expressed as Chlorophyll in Sea Water
chl.cell_methods: area: mean where sea time: mean
chl.comment: sum of chlorophyll from all phytoplankton group concentrations.  In most models this is equal to chldiat+chlmisc, that is the sum of "Diatom Chlorophyll Mass Concentration" plus "Other Phytoplankton Chlorophyll Mass Concentration"
chl.grid: native gx1v7 displaced pole grid (384x320 latxlon)
chl.experiment: all-forcing simulation of the recent past

deptho.comment: Ocean bathymetry. Reported here is the sea floor depth for present day relative to z=0 geoid. Reported as missing for land grid cells.
deptho.grid: native gx1v7 displaced pole grid (384x320 latxlon)
deptho.experiment: all-forcing simulation of the recent past

dfe.cell_methods: area: mean where sea time: mean
dfe.comment: dissolved iron in sea water is meant to include both Fe2+ and Fe3+ ions (but not, e.g., particulate detrital iron)
dfe.grid: native gx1v7 displaced pole grid (384x320 latxlon)
dfe.experiment: all-forcing simulation of the recent past

dissic.cell_methods: area: mean where sea time: mean
dissic.grid: native gx1v7 displaced pole grid (384x320 latxlon)
dissic.experiment: all-forcing simulation of the recent past

dissoc.cell_methods: area: mean where sea time: mean
dissoc.comment: Sum of dissolved carbon component concentrations explicitly represented (i.e. not ~40 uM refractory unless explicit)
dissoc.grid: native gx1v7 displaced pole grid (384x320 latxlon)
dissoc.experiment: all-forcing simulation of the recent past

intdoc.cell_methods: area: mean where sea depth: sum where sea time: mean
intdoc.grid: native gx1v7 displaced pole grid (384x320 latxlon)
intdoc.experiment: all-forcing simulation of the recent past

mlotst.long_name: Ocean Mixed Layer Thickness Defined by Sigma T

mlotst.grid: native gx1v7 displaced pole grid (384x320 latxlon)
mlotst.experiment: all-forcing simulation of the recent past

no3.cell_methods: area: mean where sea time: mean
no3.comment: Mole concentration means moles (amount of substance) per unit volume and is used in the construction mole_concentration_of_X_in_Y, where X is a material constituent of Y.
no3.grid: native gx1v7 displaced pole grid (384x320 latxlon)
no3.experiment: all-forcing simulation of the recent past

ph.cell_methods: area: mean where sea time: mean
ph.comment: negative log10 of hydrogen ion concentration with the concentration expressed as mol H kg-1.
ph.grid: native gx1v7 displaced pole grid (384x320 latxlon)
ph.experiment: all-forcing simulation of the recent past

phycos.cell_methods: area: mean where sea time: mean
phycos.comment: sum of phytoplankton carbon component concentrations.  In most (all?) cases this is the sum of phycdiat and phycmisc (i.e., "Diatom Carbon Concentration" and "Non-Diatom Phytoplankton Carbon Concentration"
phycos.grid: native gx1v7 displaced pole grid (384x320 latxlon)
phycos.experiment: all-forcing simulation of the recent past

po4.cell_methods: area: mean where sea time: mean
po4.comment: Mole concentration means number of moles per unit volume, also called "molarity", and is used in the construction "mole_concentration_of_X_in_Y", where X is a material constituent of Y. A chemical or biological species denoted by X may be described by a single term such as "nitrogen" or a phrase such as "nox_expressed_as_nitrogen". "Dissolved inorganic phosphorus" means the sum of all inorganic ph
po4.grid: native gx1v7 displaced pole grid (384x320 latxlon)
po4.experiment: all-forcing simulation of the recent past

sftof.comment: This is the area fraction at the ocean surface.
sftof.grid: native gx1v7 displaced pole grid (384x320 latxlon)

si.cell_methods: area: mean where sea time: mean
si.comment: Mole concentration means number of moles per unit volume, also called "molarity", and is used in the construction "mole_concentration_of_X_in_Y", where X is a material constituent of Y. A chemical or biological species denoted by X may be described by a single term such as "nitrogen" or a phrase such as "nox_expressed_as_nitrogen". "Dissolved inorganic silicon" means the sum of all inorganic silic
si.grid: native gx1v7 displaced pole grid (384x320 latxlon)
si.experiment: all-forcing simulation of the recent past

so.cell_methods: area: mean where sea time: mean
so.comment: Sea water salinity is the salt content of sea water, often on the Practical Salinity Scale of 1978. However, the unqualified term 'salinity' is generic and does not necessarily imply any particular method of calculation. The units of salinity are dimensionless and the units attribute should normally be given as 1e-3 or 0.001 i.e. parts per thousand.
so.grid: native gx1v7 displaced pole grid (384x320 latxlon)
so.experiment: all-forcing simulation of the recent past

talk.cell_methods: area: mean where sea time: mean

thetao.cell_methods: area: mean where sea time: mean

thetao.experiment: all-forcing simulation of the recent past

tos.cell_methods: area: mean where sea time: mean

uo.comment: Prognostic x-ward velocity component resolved by the model.

uo.experiment: all-forcing simulation of the recent past

vo.comment: Prognostic y-ward velocity component resolved by the model.

wo.comment: Prognostic z-ward velocity component resolved by the model.

chl.long_name: Mass Concentration of Total Phytoplankton expressed as Chlorophyll in sea water
chl.cell_methods: area: mean where sea time: mean
chl.comment: Model data on the 1x1 grid includes values in all cells for which any ocean exists on the native grid. For mapping purposes, we recommend using a land mask such as World Ocean Atlas to cover these areas of partial land.  For calculating approximate integrals, we recommend multiplying by cell volume (volcello).
chl.grid: ocean data regridded from tripolar - nominal 0.5 deg latitude/longitude to 180,360; interpolation method: conserve_order1
chl.experiment: update of RCP4.5 based on SSP2

o2sat.experiment: update of RCP4.5 based on SSP2

so.cell_methods: area: mean where sea time: mean

The units of salinity are dimensionless and the units attribute should normally be given as 1e-3 or 0.001 i.e. parts per thousand.
